# Milestone 4 benchmark results — multi-camera RTSP ingestion

**Actual measurements**, 2026-11-12, generated by `scripts/benchmark_ingestion.py`.

Hardware: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 4060 Laptop GPU (power limit 55.00 W), AMD Ryzen 7 8845HS w/ Radeon 780M Graphics (16 logical cores). Simulated cameras: local GStreamer RTSP servers looping MOT17-02/-04/-09/-11, 1920×1080, 30 fps, H.264 (x264 ultrafast, 4 Mbit/s), RTSP over TCP on 127.0.0.1. Detector: `yolov8m-worldv2` (FP32, batch 1), prompt `person`; ByteTrack on the CPU.

## A. Ingestion only (decode + RGB conversion, no detector)

| cameras | decode threads | input fps per camera (min–max) | process CPU (% of one core) | simulated cameras' CPU |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | 1 | 30.0–30.0 | 11 % | 50.7 % |
| 2 | 1 | 30.0–30.0 | 21 % | 102.8 % |
| 4 | 1 | 30.0–30.0 | 43 % | 194.2 % |
| 4 | FFmpeg default | 30.0–30.0 | 76 % | 177.0 % |

## B. Full pipeline: RTSP → detector → ByteTrack

| cameras | target fps per camera | processed fps per camera (min–max) | throughput fps | latency p50 / p90 ms (median over cameras) | detector ms p50 | process CPU | GPU util mean | detector peak MiB |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | 10 | 10.0–10.0 | 10.0 | 15.9 / 16.7 | 12.9 | 27 % | 10.0 % | 211.1 |
| 2 | 10 | 10.0–10.0 | 20.0 | 18.3 / 20.4 | 13.2 | 56 % | 20.0 % | 211.1 |
| 4 | 10 | 10.0–10.0 | 39.9 | 19.1 / 26.7 | 13.4 | 117 % | 39.0 % | 211.1 |
| 1 | max | 30.0–30.0 | 30.0 | 16.1 / 16.8 | 12.9 | 59 % | 30.0 % | 211.1 |
| 2 | max | 30.0–30.0 | 60.0 | 14.9 / 17.4 | 10.7 | 110 % | 46.6 % | 211.1 |
| 4 | max | 16.8–16.8 | 67.2 | 32.1 / 46.3 | 11.5 | 150 % | 53.2 % | 211.1 |

Latency = from the moment a decoded frame is available to the moment its tracks are ready (waiting + detector + ByteTrack). It excludes network, encoding and the decoder's own buffering (see D).

## C. Outages with 4 cameras running (pipeline at 10 fps per camera)

| event | measured |
|---|---|
| cam02 server stopped → reader notices | 0.01 s |
| cam02 down for | 15.0 s |
| cam02 server back → streaming again | 9.12 s |
| cam02 streaming again → first frame of the new epoch processed | 0.0 s |
| cam02 retry waits (backoff) | 1.14, 1.93, 3.20, 6.42, 10.51 s |
| cam02 tracker resets / highest local ID before / lowest after | 1 / 202 / 208 |
| cam03 frozen (silent) → `stalled` flag | 0.98 s |
| cam03 frozen → reader drops the connection | 4.01 s |
| cam03 resumed → streaming again | 0.95 s |
| cam01 / cam04 processed fps before / during cam02 outage / during cam03 freeze | cam01: 9.99 / 9.99 / 9.98 ; cam04: 9.99 / 9.99 / 9.98 |

## D. Frames held in the FFmpeg decoder (camera frozen after 60 frames)

| decode threads | frames still delivered after the freeze | hidden latency at 30 fps | read failed after |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | 1 | 33.3 ms | 4.02 s (read timeout 2 s) |
| 2 | 2 | 66.7 ms | 6.03 s (read timeout 2 s) |
| 4 | 4 | 133.3 ms | 6.03 s (read timeout 2 s) |
| ffmpeg default | 16 | 533.3 ms | 6.04 s (read timeout 2 s) |

Reproduce: `python scripts/benchmark_ingestion.py` (needs the system GStreamer RTSP server; see docs/installation.md).
